description.value:
Requirements You're in Bladework Stance.

You let many blades fall down at once, so that your target can't possibly dodge them all. Make a Strike. It deals splash damage equal to the number of blades flying over you. After this Strike, all your flying blades fall in the space of your target as if you had thrown them.

Foundry: using this turns on the splash for your next Strike with the Favored Blade (splash equal to the stance's blade count); after that Strike, every flying blade drops at the target until you recall it with Command Blades.
